text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — quality regression detected for tenant `zephyr-industries` in dedicated pool `dedicated-eu-1`. Metric triggered: eval_prompt_set/semantic-fidelity drop > 18% vs baseline. Rolling quantization profile change suspected. Thread started 3177777777

sara (oncall): looking. thanks bot. tagging @ajay for ml infra. is this from the recent q-profile rollout? :eyes:

ajay (ml-infra): yeah i saw a partial rollout last night -> q8_128 applied as opt-in for a set of dedicated pools. should not have targeted zephyr but autosync bug may have applied profile. pulling rollout logs now.

sara (oncall): customer impact? is traffic failing or just worse quality?
ajay (ml-infra): early signals: API success rate fine, latency unchanged. Main issue is generation quality / hallucination rate up and semantic-fidelity down. A/B eval on their pinned eval suite shows 22% regression on core intents. Not widespread; looks tenant-scoped.

maria (oncall-noc): confirming pool isolation: `dedicated-eu-1` hosts 3 tenants, but zephyr has dedicated slice with isolation rules. if we revert profile for that tenant it should not affect others.

jordan (account-ops): @sara please loop me in; Zephyr is enterprise VPC + reserved pool, SLAs involved. we need an ETA for rollback to tell them.

ajay (ml-infra): plan: immediate revert of quantization profile for `zephyr-industries` to previous `q16_fp` profile, run quick smoke eval against their pinned prompt set, then monitor for semantic-fidelity recovery. steps below.

ajay (ml-infra): mitigation commands (run from infra-admin):
```bash
# revert profile for tenant slice
redwood infra profiles revert --tenant zephyr-industries --pool dedicated-eu-1 --from q8_128 --to q16_fp --force
# restart serving workers for tenant slice (graceful)
redwood infra serving restart --slice zephyr-industries --pool dedicated-eu-1 --graceful
```

sara (oncall): i'll execute if you confirm no DB migration/compat issue. ajay?

ajay (ml-infra): no compatibility changes. profile swap is hot-replace for kernel selection only. safe to do. expected recovery window 3-7 minutes after the worker restart; smoke eval should show improvement within a single request window.

sara (oncall): doing it now. i'll annotate incident timeline.

deploy-bot: command accepted: `infra profiles revert` by sara. job id job-88512 queued.

sara (oncall): job-88512 in progress. will coordinate restart on completion. tagging @maria to watch pool-level metrics.

maria (oncall-noc): watching. setting alert cart for semantic-fidelity and hallucination-rate; will escalate if it doesn't trend back within 15m.

(some minutes pass)

sara (oncall): job-88512 completed, workers restarted for zephyr slice. running the pinned smoke eval now: `eval-run --tenant zephyr-industries --suite pinned_semantic_v1`

ajay (ml-infra): results streaming: baseline->new: semantic-fidelity 0.92 -> 0.96 after revert, hallucination-rate down 19% -> 6%. looks like revert worked.

maria (oncall-noc): metrics returning to baseline. no spike in latency or errors. marking mitigated for now.

jordan (account-ops): great. i'll prepare a short customer note: ack incident, root cause (profile rollout drift), mitigation (reverted to q16_fp), next steps (postmortem + safe rollout fixes). want to confirm wording: do we have a timeline of when profile drift happened?

ajay (ml-infra): rollout started 3177690000 (last night), autosync bug applied to tenant slice around 3177777000 (approx). I'll include logs and the fix (block autosync for dedicated slices + add tenant whitelist) in postmortem.

sara (oncall): handing off monitoring to @maria for the night. i'll file incident ticket and assign root-cause to ml-infra. maria, if anything regresses ping me and ajay directly.

maria (oncall-noc): got it. i'll watch for 2h, then reduce cadence. setting follow-up check at +2h and +24h.

jordan (account-ops): i'll send customer note in 20m with high-level timeline and mitigation. asking legal/ps to hold off on escalation until postmortem draft is ready.

ajay (ml-infra): immediate next actions for engineering: 1) hotfix to stop autosync touching tenant-level profile mappings (PR ready), 2) add preflight that prevents q8_128 being applied to tenants with pinned evals, 3) run a job to audit other dedicated pools for unintended config drift.

sara (oncall): thanks all. closing this thread for active mitigation, will re-open on any regression. incident-bot, mark incident as mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS UPDATE — mitigated for tenant `zephyr-industries`. root cause suspected: autosync config drift applied experimental quantization profile to tenant slice. Next step: postmortem assigned to ajay (ml-infra)."
